CustomField.description: ASUPGA eligibility is determined by the student's ASUPGA status. This field is updated during the ASUPGA process, either by the student's actions (accept/decline) or automatically by the system if no action is taken (cancelled). The data for this field is sourced from PS_ASU_AA_AA_ELIG in PeopleSoft.
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
This field indicates the current status of the student's ASUPGA offer. The possible statuses are:
Offered: The offer has been made to the student.
Accepted: The student has accepted the offer.
Declined: The student has declined the offer.
Cancelled: The deadline for the offer has passed and the student is no longer eligible for ASUPGA.
Not Eligible: The student is not eligible for the offer.
CustomField.label: ASUPGA Status
